#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <limits>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

struct Pair {
    long long first;
    long long second;
};

struct Edge {
    int id;
};

class Graph {
public:
    static const int REMOVED_BIT = 0;
    int vertexCount;
    int edgeCount;
    vector<int> firstOutbound;
    vector<int> firstInbound;
    vector<Edge> edges;
    vector<int> nextInbound;
    vector<int> nextOutbound;
    vector<int> from;
    vector<int> to;
    vector<long long> weight;
    vector<long long> capacity;
    vector<int> reverseEdge;
    vector<int> flags;

    Graph(int vertexCount_) : vertexCount(vertexCount_) {
        firstOutbound.assign(vertexCount, -1);
        firstInbound.assign(vertexCount, -1);
    }

    int addEdge(int fromID, int toID, long long w, long long cap, int revEdge=-1) {
        ensureEdgeCapacity(edgeCount + 1);
        if (firstOutbound[fromID] != -1)
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = firstOutbound[fromID];
        else
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = -1;
        firstOutbound[fromID] = edgeCount;
        if (!nextInbound.empty()) {
            if (firstInbound[toID] != -1)
                nextInbound[edgeCount] = firstInbound[toID];
            else
                nextInbound[edgeCount] = -1;
            firstInbound[toID] = edgeCount;
        }
        from.push_back(fromID);
        to.push_back(toID);
        if (cap != 0) {
            if (capacity.size() < from.size())
                capacity.resize(from.size(), 0);
            capacity.push_back(cap);
        }
        if (w != 0) {
            if (weight.size() < from.size())
                weight.resize(from.size(), 0);
            weight.push_back(w);
        }
        if (revEdge != -1) {
            if (reverseEdge.size() < from.size())
                reverseEdge.resize(from.size(), -1);
            reverseEdge.push_back(revEdge);
        }
        edges.emplace_back(Edge{edgeCount});
        return edgeCount++;
    }

private:
    void ensureEdgeCapacity(int size) {
        if (from.size() < size) {
            int newSize = max(size, 2 * (int)from.size());
            from.reserve(newSize);
            to.reserve(newSize);
            nextOutbound.resize(newSize);
            if (!nextInbound.empty())
                nextInbound.resize(newSize);
            if (!weight.empty())
                weight.resize(newSize);
            if (!capacity.empty())
                capacity.resize(newSize);
            if (!reverseEdge.empty())
                reverseEdge.resize(newSize);
            flags.resize(newSize);
        }
    }
    int edgeCount = 0;
};

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    MinCostFlow(Graph& g_, int s_, int t_, bool hasNegative): g(g_), s(s_), t(t_), vertexCount(g_.vertexCount) {
        phi.assign(vertexCount, LLONG_MAX);
        if (hasNegative) {
            fordBellman();
        }
        dijkstraResult.assign(vertexCount, LLONG_MAX);
        lastEdge.assign(vertexCount, -1);
        if (g.isSparse()) {
            struct Compare {
                bool operator()(int a, int b) {
                    return dijkstraResult[a] > dijkstraResult[b];
                }
            };
            heap = priority_queue<int, vector<int>, Compare>();
        } else {
            visited.assign(vertexCount, 0);
        }
    }

    static Pair minCostMaxFlow(Graph& g, int s, int t, bool hasNegative, long long maxFlow) {
        MinCostFlow mcf(g, s, t, hasNegative);
        return mcf.minCostMaxFlow(maxFlow);
    }

    Pair minCostMaxFlow(long long maxFlow) {
        long long cost = 0;
        long long flow = 0;
        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            if (g.isSparse()) {
                dijkstraAlgorithm();
            } else {
                dijkstraAlgorithmFull();
            }
            if (lastEdge[t] == -1) {
                return {cost, flow};
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < dijkstraResult.size(); i++) {
                if (dijkstraResult[i] != LLONG_MAX)
                    phi[i] += dijkstraResult[i];
            }
            long long currentFlow = maxFlow;
            long long currentCost = 0;
            int v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[v];
                currentFlow = min(currentFlow, g.capacity[edgeID]);
                currentCost += g.weight[edgeID];
                v = g.from[edgeID];
            }
            maxFlow -= currentFlow;
            cost += currentCost * currentFlow;
            flow += currentFlow;
            v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[v];
                g.pushFlow(edgeID, currentFlow);
                v = g.from[edgeID];
            }
        }
        return {cost, flow};
    }

private:
    Graph& g;
    int s, t;
    int vertexCount;
    vector<long long> phi;
    vector<long long> dijkstraResult;
    vector<int> lastEdge;
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, function<bool(int,int)>> heap;
    vector<int> visited;
    int visitIndex = 0;

    void fordBellman() {
        fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        phi[s] = 0;
        vector<bool> inQueue(vertexCount, false);
        vector<int> queue(vertexCount + 1);
        int head=0, end=1;
        queue[0]=s;
        inQueue[s]=true;
        int stepCount=0;
        int maxSteps=2*vertexCount*vertexCount;
        while(head!=end) {
            int vertex=queue[head++];
            if(head==queue.size()) head=0;
            inQueue[vertex]=false;
            int edgeID=g.firstOutbound(vertex);
            while(edgeID!=-1) {
                long long total=phi[vertex]+g.weight[edgeID];
                int destination=g.to[edgeID];
                if(g.capacity[edgeID]!=0 && phi[destination]>total) {
                    phi[destination]=total;
                    if(!inQueue[destination]) {
                        queue[end++]=destination;
                        inQueue[destination]=true;
                        if(end==queue.size()) end=0;
                    }
                }
                edgeID=g.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
            if(++stepCount>maxSteps) throw runtime_error("Graph contains negative cycle");
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithm() {
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[s]=0;
        for(int i=0; i<vertexCount; i++) {
            int u=-1;
            long long minDist=LLONG_MAX;
            for(int j=0; j<vertexCount; j++) {
                if(visited[j]!=visitIndex && dijkstraResult[j]<minDist) {
                    minDist=dijkstraResult[j];
                    u=j;
                }
            }
            if(u==-1) return;
            visited[u]=visitIndex;
            int edgeID=g.firstOutbound(u);
            while(edgeID!=-1) {
                if(g.capacity[edgeID]!=0) {
                    int v=g.to[edgeID];
                    long long total=g.weight[edgeID]-phi[v]+phi[u]+dijkstraResult[u];
                    if(dijkstraResult[v]>total) {
                        dijkstraResult[v]=total;
                        lastEdge[v]=edgeID;
                    }
                }
                edgeID=g.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithmFull() {
        ++visitIndex;
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[t]=0;
        for(int i=0; i<vertexCount; i++) {
            int u=-1;
            long long minDist=LLONG_MAX;
            for(int j=0; j<vertexCount; j++) {
                if(visited[j]!=visitIndex && dijkstraResult[j]<minDist) {
                    minDist=dijkstraResult[j];
                    u=j;
                }
            }
            if(u==-1) return;
            visited[u]=visitIndex;
            int edgeID=g.firstOutbound(u);
            while(edgeID!=-1) {
                if(g.capacity[edgeID]!=0) {
                    int v=g.to[edgeID];
                    long long total=g.weight[edgeID]-phi[v]+phi[u]+dijkstraResult[u];
                    if(dijkstraResult[v]>total) {
                        dijkstraResult[v]=total;
                        lastEdge[v]=edgeID;
                    }
                }
                edgeID=g.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> ugliness(n);
    for (int i=0; i<n; ++i) {
        cin >> ugliness[i];
        ugliness[i]=-ugliness[i];
    }

    int sizeGraph=1+26+n/2+1;
    Graph graph(sizeGraph);

    for (char c='a'; c<='z'; ++c) {
        for (int i=0; i<n/2; ++i) {
            int cost=0;
            if (c==s[i]) cost=min(cost, ugliness[i]);
            if (c==s[n-1-i]) cost=min(cost, ugliness[n-1-i]);
            graph.addEdge(1 + (c-'a'), 1 + 26 + i, cost, 1);
        }
    }

    vector<int> occurs(128,0);
    for (char c : s) occurs[c]++;
    for (char c='a'; c<='z'; ++c) {
        graph.addEdge(0, 1 + (c-'a'), 0, occurs[c]);
    }

    for (int i=0; i<n/2; ++i) {
        graph.addEdge(1 + 26 + i, 1 + 26 + n/2, 0, 2);
    }

    Pair flow=MinCostFlow::minCostMaxFlow(graph,0,1+26+n/2,true,n);
    cout << -flow.first << "\n";

    return 0;
}
